dialogues.jp:
俺自身でも、ああ気の迷いってヤツだなとわか
るような場所に足を踏み入れた。
dialogues.en:
It's not usual for a troublemaker like me to step into this
kind of place.
dialogues.text:
It's not usual for a troublemaker like me to step into this
kind of place.

dialogues.jp:
この落ち着いた雰囲気は嫌いじゃないし、読書
をしない訳でもない。
dialogues.en:
This quiet atmosphere isn't bad at all, but there's no
reason to be here unless you're reading something.
dialogues.text:
This quiet atmosphere isn't bad at all, but there's no
reason to be here unless you're reading something.

dialogues.jp:
だがしかし、わざわざ昼休憩をこんなところで
過ごさなくてもいいじゃないか、とそう思う訳
である。
dialogues.en:
Although it isn't a bad idea to spend the lunch rbeak here
sleeping at times...
dialogues.text:
Although it isn't a bad idea to spend the lunch rbeak here
sleeping at times...

dialogues.jp:
さて、そんな俺がここへ来た理由は、ただひと
つ……と言っても、そんな大げさなものではな
いのだが。
dialogues.en:
There's a different reason why I came here though... not a
very important one, admittedly.
dialogues.text:
There's a different reason why I came here though... not a
very important one, admittedly.

dialogues.jp:
あの、体育館の裏にある、月城が育てている草
が少しだけ気になったのだ。
dialogues.en:
I was wondering about that plant that Tsukishiro was caring
for, growing at the abck of the gym.
dialogues.text:
I was wondering about that plant that Tsukishiro was caring
for, growing at the abck of the gym.

dialogues.jp:
なんの草だかよくわからないものを、彼女は一
生懸命育てている。
dialogues.en:
Neither of us knew much about it, but she was putting so
much effort into taking care of it.
dialogues.text:
Neither of us knew much about it, but she was putting so
much effort into taking care of it.

dialogues.jp:
月城自身の不思議さも相まって、もう少し知り
たいのだと思うようになった。
dialogues.en:
Thanks to her weird obsession with it, I started wondering
about the plant myself.
dialogues.text:
Thanks to her weird obsession with it, I started wondering
about the plant myself.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.en: "A... Asakura?"
dialogues.text: "A... Asakura?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「お、なんだ、眞子じゃないか」
dialogues.en: "Ah, hey, Mako."
dialogues.text: "Ah, hey, Mako."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「あー……。今日、傘持ってきてないのよねぇ。
　ついてないわ」
dialogues.en: "Man... I didn't bring my umbrella today. What bad luck."
dialogues.text: "Man... I didn't bring my umbrella today. What bad luck."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「なんだ、その言いぐさは」
dialogues.en: "What're you talking about?"
dialogues.text: "What're you talking about?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「だって、朝倉が図書室に来るなんて、絶対雨
　が降るに決まってる。最悪槍とか降ってきた
　ら、あたしどうしよう」
dialogues.en:
"I mean, you came to the library after all, of course it's
going to rain. Geez, how will I get through that torrent..."
dialogues.text:
"I mean, you came to the library after all, of course it's
going to rain. Geez, how will I get through that torrent..."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「ひとつずつ、その鉄拳パンチで落としていけ
　よ」
dialogues.en:
"One punch from your iron fist, and the clouds will
scatter."
dialogues.text:
"One punch from your iron fist, and the clouds will
scatter."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「……なに、人をバカにした発言してんのよ」
dialogues.en: "...Stop talking about stupid crap."
dialogues.text: "...Stop talking about stupid crap."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「お互い様だろ？　それより、植物図鑑ってど
　こあるか、教えろよ」
dialogues.en:
"You first, no? More importantly, tell me where I can find
some plant encyclopedias."
dialogues.text:
"You first, no? More importantly, tell me where I can find
some plant encyclopedias."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「植物図鑑？　そんなのどうするのよ」
dialogues.en: "Plant encyclopedias? What do you want with them?"
dialogues.text: "Plant encyclopedias? What do you want with them?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「いいだろ？」
dialogues.en: "Do you know where they are?"
dialogues.text: "Do you know where they are?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「うちの学校、食べられる植物が載ってるのは、
　ないわよ」
dialogues.en: "There aren't any edible plants around this school."
dialogues.text: "There aren't any edible plants around this school."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「……誰が食用の植物を調べるって言った」
dialogues.en: "...Who said anything about eating them."
dialogues.text: "...Who said anything about eating them."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「あら、朝倉だから、そんなところかと思った
　んだけど、違ったのね」
dialogues.en:
"Oh really? Considering it was you, it was just an honest
mistake."
dialogues.text:
"Oh really? Considering it was you, it was just an honest
mistake."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「はったおすぞ、お前」
dialogues.en: "Do you know or not, sheesh."
dialogues.text: "Do you know or not, sheesh."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「ウソウソ。ちゃんと教えてあげるわよ……」
dialogues.en: "I'm just kidding around. I'd show you where..."
dialogues.text: "I'm just kidding around. I'd show you where..."

dialogues.jp:
眞子はそう言って、俺を図鑑のコーナーに案内
してくれた。
dialogues.en: Mako led me to a corner, chock full of encyclopedias.
dialogues.text: Mako led me to a corner, chock full of encyclopedias.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「何調べるのか知らないけど、はい。後は自分
　で調べられるでしょ？」
dialogues.en:
"NO idea what you're looking for, but here you go. You can
do whatever you want by yourself, right?"
dialogues.text:
"NO idea what you're looking for, but here you go. You can
do whatever you want by yourself, right?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「おお、サンキュ。さすが、眞子だね。頼りに
　なるよ」
dialogues.en: "Ohhh, thank you. Reliable as always, Mako!"
dialogues.text: "Ohhh, thank you. Reliable as always, Mako!"

dialogues.speaker: 眞子
dialogues.jp: 「調子がいいわね。さっきの態度とおー違い」
dialogues.en: "Much better, compared to how you were like earlier."
dialogues.text: "Much better, compared to how you were like earlier."

dialogues.jp:
眞子は『読んだ本はちゃんと戻しておいてね』
と最後まで口うるさいまま退場していった。
dialogues.en:
With a loud reminder to "make sure you put back whatever
books you take!", she left me to my devices.
dialogues.text:
With a loud reminder to "make sure you put back whatever
books you take!", she left me to my devices.

dialogues.jp: 俺は、適当に図鑑を取ると、空いた席を探した。
dialogues.en:
Taking a few books that seemed appropriate, I started to
search for an unoccupied table.
dialogues.text:
Taking a few books that seemed appropriate, I started to
search for an unoccupied table.

dialogues.jp:
さすがに、明日から試験が始まるせいか、一生
懸命勉強している連中が多い。
dialogues.en:
But with tomorrow being the start of exams, the amount of
people cramming was outstanding.
dialogues.text:
But with tomorrow being the start of exams, the amount of
people cramming was outstanding.

dialogues.jp: 図書室、大盛況という感じだ。
dialogues.en: The library does tend to get popular at these times.
dialogues.text: The library does tend to get popular at these times.

dialogues.jp:
邪魔にならないよう、そうっと空いた席に移動
し、おもむろにページをめくる。
dialogues.en:
Not wanting to disturb others, I eventually found an empty
table, and started searching through the books for any pages
of interest.
dialogues.text:
Not wanting to disturb others, I eventually found an empty
table, and started searching through the books for any pages
of interest.

dialogues.jp:
「しかし、名前も、種別もなんにもわからない
　んじゃあなぁ」
dialogues.en: "I don't even know it's name, or the type of plant it is..."
dialogues.text: "I don't even know it's name, or the type of plant it is..."

dialogues.jp:
ただ、ぺらぺらと図鑑のページをめくっている
が、あの花に出会うことはなかった。
dialogues.en:
Just randomly flipping through page by page like this, I'm
not going to be finding it any time soon...
dialogues.text:
Just randomly flipping through page by page like this, I'm
not going to be finding it any time soon...

dialogues.jp:
そもそも、この調べ方だと、他の図鑑全部も調
べなきゃいけないじゃないか。
dialogues.en:
I don't have the time to search through every encyclopedia
this way either.
dialogues.text:
I don't have the time to search through every encyclopedia
this way either.

dialogues.jp:
「へぇ……、ベニテングタケって、食えなくも
　ないのか……」
dialogues.en: "Huh... Bended bamboos aren't edible..."
dialogues.text: "Huh... Bended bamboos aren't edible..."

dialogues.jp:
などとついつい食べられるキノコを調べたりし
始めてしまった。
dialogues.en:
My attention quickly turned to all the different types of
consumable plants and mushrooms.
dialogues.text:
My attention quickly turned to all the different types of
consumable plants and mushrooms.

dialogues.jp: 「ほほう……」
dialogues.en: "Ooooh..."
dialogues.text: "Ooooh..."

dialogues.jp: 「ふむふむ」
dialogues.en: "Mmmmm."
dialogues.text: "Mmmmm."

dialogues.jp: 「こっ、これは……！」
dialogues.en: "T, this is...!"
dialogues.text: "T, this is...!"

dialogues.jp:
なんだか、意外と図鑑も面白いものだな。図柄
や説明だけでなく、暮らしに役立つ知識や、歴
史まで載っている。
dialogues.en:
This book is more interesting than I thought it'd be.
Learning what you can eat to survive is incredibly
resourceful.
dialogues.text:
This book is more interesting than I thought it'd be.
Learning what you can eat to survive is incredibly
resourceful.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.en: "...Senpai."
dialogues.text: "...Senpai."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「まあ、まて。いいところなんだから」
dialogues.en: "Wait a bit. This part is good!"
dialogues.text: "Wait a bit. This part is good!"

dialogues.jp: 声の主は置いておいて、ページをめくる。
dialogues.en: Staving off the voice, I continued flipping the pages.
dialogues.text: Staving off the voice, I continued flipping the pages.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.en: "...Senpai."
dialogues.text: "...Senpai."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「えっ」
dialogues.en: "Eh?"
dialogues.text: "Eh?"

dialogues.jp:
その声は、月城のものだった。ふと横を見ると、
いつものように人形を胸に抱いた月城が、ちょ
こんと立っていた。
dialogues.en:
That voice, it belonged to Tsukishiro. I turned my head to
the side, and saw her, standing there with the doll at her
chest.
dialogues.text:
That voice, it belonged to Tsukishiro. I turned my head to
the side, and saw her, standing there with the doll at her
chest.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……先輩、その図鑑」
dialogues.en: "...Senpai, that book."
dialogues.text: "...Senpai, that book."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「え、この図鑑？」
dialogues.en: "Uh, this book?"
dialogues.text: "Uh, this book?"

dialogues.jp: アリスがこくんと、頷く。
dialogues.en: She nodded.
dialogues.text: She nodded.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……見たいの」
dialogues.en: "...I want to read it."
dialogues.text: "...I want to read it."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「もしかして、体育館裏の草のことで？」
dialogues.en: "You mean, for the plant behind the gym?"
dialogues.text: "You mean, for the plant behind the gym?"

dialogues.jp: 再び、アリスがこくんと頷く。
dialogues.en: Yet another silent nod.
dialogues.text: Yet another silent nod.

dialogues.jp: 「そっか、悪ィ」
dialogues.en: "Ah, I see, here."
dialogues.text: "Ah, I see, here."

dialogues.jp:
そもそも、月城の育てている草を調べていると
いうのに、当の本人がその草が載っている図鑑
を読めないという話はない。
dialogues.en:
Even if I had found the plant anyway, it wouldn't be of much
use until Tsukishiro herself reads about it.
dialogues.text:
Even if I had found the plant anyway, it wouldn't be of much
use until Tsukishiro herself reads about it.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……ごめんなさい」
dialogues.en: "...I'm sorry."
dialogues.text: "...I'm sorry."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp:
「いいよいいよ。俺も月城が育ててた草のこと
　を調べてたんだから」
dialogues.en:
"It's fine, fine! I was trying to find out more about it
like you, anyway."
dialogues.text:
"It's fine, fine! I was trying to find out more about it
like you, anyway."

dialogues.jp:
月城がきょとんとした目で首を傾げる。人形も
同じように首を傾げた。
dialogues.en:
At my exclamation, her head tilted sideways in puzzlement.
The doll mimicked her movements.
dialogues.text:
At my exclamation, her head tilted sideways in puzzlement.
The doll mimicked her movements.

dialogues.jp: 「いや、ちょっと気になったからさ」
dialogues.en: "Uh, I was just worried about it."
dialogues.text: "Uh, I was just worried about it."

dialogues.jp: 俺は、図鑑をぱたんと閉じて、月城に渡す。
dialogues.en: I hurriedly closed the book, and handed it over to Alice.
dialogues.text: I hurriedly closed the book, and handed it over to Alice.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.en: "...Mushrooms?"
dialogues.text: "...Mushrooms?"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「え？　あ……や、ちょっとね」
dialogues.en: "Eh? Ah.... kinda."
dialogues.text: "Eh? Ah.... kinda."

dialogues.jp: しっかり、見られていたとは。
dialogues.en: Her stare would make a grown man wilt.
dialogues.text: Her stare would make a grown man wilt.

dialogues.jp: 俺は、ハハハと笑いながら、席を立つ。
dialogues.en: Trying to laugh it off loudly, I stood up from the desk.
dialogues.text: Trying to laugh it off loudly, I stood up from the desk.

dialogues.jp:
ジロリと、図書室にいた連中のほぼ全員から敵
意｛む／剥｝き出しの視線を向けられる。
dialogues.en:
And that got me even more unwanted attention from the rest
of the people in the library, staring me down
disapprovingly.
dialogues.text:
And that got me even more unwanted attention from the rest
of the people in the library, staring me down
disapprovingly.

dialogues.jp: 「ハハハ……って、はい……出て行きますよ」
dialogues.en: "Hahaha... um, okay... I'm going."
dialogues.text: "Hahaha... um, okay... I'm going."

dialogues.jp: 「じゃあな、月城」
dialogues.en: "Later, Tsukishiro!"
dialogues.text: "Later, Tsukishiro!"

dialogues.jp:
俺はそう言って、そそくさと図書室を出て行っ
た。やはり、ここは俺のくるようなところでは
なかったようだ。
dialogues.en:
I escaped from the library almost before my words stopped
echoing around it. This really isn't a place for me...
dialogues.text:
I escaped from the library almost before my words stopped
echoing around it. This really isn't a place for me...

dialogues.jp: ◆月城の花◆
dialogues.en: ◆Tsukishiro's Flower◆
dialogues.text: ◆Tsukishiro's Flower◆

dialogues.jp:
月城が育てている草のことが気になって、俺は
図書室へ調べにやってきた。
dialogues.en:
With Tsukishiro's reared plant on my mind, I went ot the
library to read up on it.
dialogues.text:
With Tsukishiro's reared plant on my mind, I went ot the
library to read up on it.

dialogues.jp:
図鑑を片っ端から探していったが、名前もわか
らず花の形もわからずでは、調べようがなかっ
た。
dialogues.en:
I flipped through some encyclopedia, but wihtout knowledge
of it's name or the flowers it blooms, I couldn't find it.
dialogues.text:
I flipped through some encyclopedia, but wihtout knowledge
of it's name or the flowers it blooms, I couldn't find it.

dialogues.jp:
そこへ、月城がやってきて、俺が見ている図鑑
が読みたいのだという。俺は、図鑑をゆずり、
図書室を出るのだった。
dialogues.en:
Then, Tsukishiro appeared, wanting to read the book I was
looking at. I hastily handed it over. And quickly left the
library.
dialogues.text:
Then, Tsukishiro appeared, wanting to read the book I was
looking at. I hastily handed it over. And quickly left the
library.
